description: Quivra generates TypeScript clients from OpenAPI using project-owned MiniJinja templates.

image.alt: Quivra wordmark beside glass specification plates connected through a plum bracket to ceramic code tiles.

icon.alt: A dark purple Q with a lavender square at its center.

artwork.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create a polished 16:9 portfolio cover for Quivra, a Pixel Brewery CLI turning OpenAPI specs and templates into typed clients. Match the supplied Cursor and Archipel cards' warm white seamless studio, generous 7% safe margins, soft shadows, premium on-axis wordmark and tactile ceramic/glass look. Left third: a simple dark aubergine brand symbol above the large black exact word “Quivra” (Q-u-i-v-r-a). The mark is an angular Q formed by a thick rounded-square open loop with an attached short diagonal tail at lower right, and small violet square in the negative-space center. Right two thirds: an elegant asymmetric still life of two upright translucent glass specification plates with simple embossed diagrams, transitioning through a plum ceramic bracket into three neatly aligned ivory output tiles with a few raised graphite code-like lines; one muted lavender accent. The artwork conveys one source shaped into typed client modules. Preserve the scene’s calm editorial clarity and avoid copying the reference products’ shapes. No text except the exact wordmark, no UI screenshot, no tagline, no watermark. Art must reach all edges with a seamless near-white background.
artwork.iconPrompt: Use case: logo. A finished flat square product icon for Quivra on a true transparent background. A simple dark aubergine (#452a64) angular Q formed by one thick rounded-square open loop with an attached short diagonal tail at lower right, and one small lavender (#9b77d0) square centered in the negative space. The distinctive outline must read as a Q at 24px. Center the symbol with even generous transparent margins and precise, smooth edges. Just the mark, no wordmark, gradients, framing tile, textures, shadow, watermark, or lettering besides the symbol. Match the restraint of contemporary Pixel Brewery developer-tool app marks.
